summary: Iteration-6 full validation of the four new CIVIO features (team invites, company-branded reports, residential homeowner dashboard, public landing page). Added /app/backend/tests/test_new_features_iter6.py with 13 pytest tests — ALL PASS. Combined with the prior multi-tenant suite, 29/29 backend tests pass (test_multitenant_saas.py: 16/16, test_new_features_iter6.py: 13/13). Frontend verified via Playwright: landing-page served to anonymous users (desktop and 390px mobile), contact-email mailto href = mailto:civiobuilds@gmail.com, contact-phone tel href = tel:+919108098446, both landing-signin-btn and hero-register-btn navigate correctly, logged-in users are NOT shown the landing page; People -> invite-person-btn opens dialog, send-invite-btn returns invite-link + copy-invite-link-btn, invite-list shows invite-row + invite-status + revoke-invite-btn; opening /invite/{token} logged-out shows accept-invite-page with company 'CIVIO PMC', completing the form lands on the dashboard; /settings renders company-settings-page with all seven inputs + save-settings-btn + logo-file-input + logo-preview + workspace-badge; PM cannot see nav-settings. Branded PDF: generate_report returns in <15s and pypdf-extracted text contains the display_name 'CIVIO PMC', the footer 'Powered by CIVIO', and 'Confidential'. Homeowner flow: created a residential enterprise end-to-end (register-enterprise + email_verified + super-admin approve + create engineer+client + project + milestone + activity with requires_client_approval + progress-update + PM review -> pending_client_decision), logged in as the client and verified every documented data-testid (home-hero, home-progress-ring, home-progress-value, home-decision-card, home-approve-btn, home-request-changes-btn, home-timeline, home-milestone, home-phase, home-team-card, home-team-member, home-photos); 'Request changes' dialog submits home-decision-comment and the card is replaced by home-no-decisions. Commercial client (client@civio.build) STILL sees the old dashboard (stat-* cards), not the homeowner view. All TEST_ enterprises/users/invites/projects were cleaned up; civio enterprise doc restored to display_name='CIVIO PMC' with the pre-existing logo intact.

minor.issue: Previously-revoked invite emails get stored lower-cased (server lowercases) so clients must compare lower-case; harmless but should be documented.

Expects top-level 'name'/'email'/'phone' for the owner (not 'owner_name'/'owner_email'/'owner_phone'). Field naming is inconsistent with the rest of the enterprise payload — potential source of confusion for API consumers.

POST /invites requires 'origin' header starting with https:// which browsers always send for the preview app, but direct API consumers (curl/postman) must set Origin header manually. Document this in README.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The invite / settings / homeowner / landing features are covered by /app/backend/tests/test_new_features_iter6.py. Key gotchas: (1) server LOWERCASES all emails on store — compare with email.lower(). (2) /auth/register-enterprise expects {name,email,phone} top-level, not owner_*. (3) OTP bypass: db.users.update_one({email:lower},{$set:{email_verified:True}}). (4) Progress update endpoint is POST /projects/{pid}/progress-updates (not /progress-updates). (5) ReviewIn uses 'action' not 'decision'. (6) PDF text is Flate+ASCII85-compressed — use pypdf to extract when asserting branding. (7) Invite POST requires an https:// Origin header. (8) Super-admin approval POST /superadmin/enterprises/{eid}/status with {status:'active',reason:''}. (9) Mongo DB is 'test_database' at mongodb://localhost:27017.
